name: com.akexorcist.localizationactivity.BlankDummyActivity
description: AkeXorcist LocalizationActivity launches this brief blank screen during a language change, then closes it with the library's transition. It is a handoff while the host screen is recreated in the new locale.
disableEffect: Disabling it can interrupt the locale-change handoff, so the app's language-change flow may fail.
